chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
No servant recites Surah Bani Israel every Thursday night without dying before he meets the Qaim (peace be upon him) and becomes one of his companions.

key_terms.سُورَةَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: Surah Bani Israel (Chapter 17 of the Quran)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Bani Israel on Thursday night?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration linking the nightly recitation of Surah Bani Israel on Thursday evenings to the specific blessing of longevity, ensuring the believer lives to witness the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on active preparation for the Occultation by cultivating spiritual readiness and maintaining a connection with the future Imam through consistent devotional acts.
